partners.mechanism_chain: CEP41 (HGNC:27714) —DISRUPTS→ ciliary protein trafficking; NDE1 (HGNC:7749) —DISRUPTS→ ciliary protein trafficking; ciliary protein trafficking —LEADS_TO→ neuronal development; neuronal development —LEADS_TO→ Microhydranencephaly (HP:0001305); neuronal development —LEADS_TO→ Severe intellectual disability (HP:0010864).
